claim_boundary: An idealized axisymmetric circular-torus transport comparison with explicitly authored surrogate materials and a cold-data salt. Not an ARC geometry/material/source reproduction, operating liquid blanket model, experiment validation, qualified design prediction, coil failure/service life, or electricity result.

excluded_material_regions.reason: No dedicated layer in the current radial material map; Be9 remains in Li2BeF4. Adding the ARC separate 1cm multiplier would change the authored layer budget/transport geometry and must be an explicit future comparison input.
Use elemental pure-Fe structural surrogate in this bounded input case. Do not label it Inconel or infer Inconel response.

not_supported: tritium process recovery or startup reserve
history_and_plant_claims.rust_history_scope: May use verified normalized source-rate responses as explicitly conditional inputs for arithmetic inventory/exposure/power bookkeeping only after its own independent controls pass.

arc_hot_liquid_density_reference.limitation: Design-property table value; isotope/composition basis is not sufficiently specified to transfer as an exact 90%-Li6 measurement. Not used in cold-state density.
arc_hot_liquid_density_reference.source: Sorbom et al. 2015 ARC paper, Table 5

density_method.assumption: No Li-isotope-dependent unit-cell-volume change; no uncertainty assigned to this transfer. This is not a measurement or assay of 90%-Li6 salt.
density_method.isotope_reweighting: rho_target = rho_reference * M_formula_target / M_formula_reference, holding the measured solid unit-cell volume fixed
density_method.reference_isotopic_basis: Li7/Li6=10500(500); calculation uses the reported central ratio as a molecular-mass proxy

materials.density_type: explicit model assumption, derived isotope-mass reweighting
limitations: solid crystalline state, not ARC flowing liquid FLiBe
measured composition is highly Li7-enriched rather than 90% Li6
density is crystal density, not blanket bulk/homogenized density
chemistry, impurity, porosity and texture not represented

recipe.be_f_assumption: Be9=100%, F19=100% for natural single-stable-isotope representation

materials.source: Gardner et al. 2025 X-ray solid-density fit, Table 4; DOI 10.1107/S1600576725000548

limitations: no tile gaps, coating, alloy or porosity
scenario first-wall shell is 0.03 m authored geometry, not ARC one-centimeter armor
no alloy chemistry, welds, ribs, porosity or temperature expansion
materials.source: NIST Journal of Research determination: 7.874 +/- 0.001 g/cm3

materials.density_type: theoretical crystalline density used as model assumption
limitations: ARC describes TiH2 powder; theoretical density is not packed bulk density
ideal H/Ti=2, no phase mix/dehydrogenation, void, canister or coolant
materials.phase: ideal stoichiometric TiH2 crystal at 293.6 K
materials.source: Du et al. powder-compaction study, theoretical TiH2 density 3.75 g/cm3

materials.density_type: sourced NIST selected-metal value at 295 K, used at 293.6 K as negligible-temperature-offset model input
limitations: transport response region only, not REBCO conductor or coil assembly
no coil failure threshold or component-life model
materials.source: NIST Center for Neutron Research, selected metal properties table

model_geometry.geometry_scope: Preserve all shared shell dimensions and material identities across both variants. Confirm radial closure and cell volumes after transport geometry generation. Existing scenario does not model ports, divertor, supports, blanket flow channels, coil packs, or local penetrations.
model_geometry.shape: concentric full circular tori; axisymmetric 2-D material allocation represented in 3-D OpenMC CSG

transport.data_uncertainty: No response-specific nuclear-data uncertainty or covariance propagation is included in this input candidate. Do not treat Monte Carlo tally precision as total model uncertainty.
transport.photon_transport: All listed secondary photon product records have distributions in neutron data and photoatomic files are present for requested elements. Coupled neutron-photon energy deposition has not been run/verified; MT301 and gamma data presence alone do not constitute total heating evidence.

assumptions: constant 525 MW total D-T fusion power
isotropic direction, no plasma rotation/thermal broadening/angular correlation
source.birth_space: uniform in modeled full toroidal plasma volume
source.status: authored simplified source, not the ARC Monte Carlo source prescription
source.strength_formula: 525e6 W / (17.6e6 eV/fusion reaction * 1.602176634e-19 J/eV); one neutron per D-T reaction

tallies.domain: blanket breeder only; the component-level `blanket-tritium` response
tallies.normalization: tritium nuclei per source neutron; with exactly one source neutron per D-T reaction, gross T births per source are the idealized TBR for modeled Li material
tallies.scope_limit: gross production only; no extraction/recovery/decay/retention/startup inventory. The whole-model aggregate includes all modeled regions, including a trace possible H3 contribution from TiH2 shield hydrogen, so do not treat that aggregate as breeder-only TBR.
tallies.status: score route data present; actual tally, per-nuclide mechanism, uncertainty and normalization must be verified by OpenMC run

tallies.scope_limit: 0.1 MeV cutoff is descriptive and inherited from an ARC Nb3Sn discussion; it is not a Cu/REBCO service criterion

tallies.scope_limit: not dpa without displacement model/threshold; not failure or lifetime
tallies.status: MT444 file present; actual score run test required
tallies.units: eV/source prior to absolute scaling; report tally estimator/volume

transport.temperature_limit: All audited target nuclides have only 294K data. No hot-case temperature interpolation/broadening is asserted.

temperature_selection.meaning: Compare against numeric stored kT at 0.1 K. OpenMC 0.15.3 accesses this table via rounded integer label 294K and needs separate 1 K label-selection tolerance. This is not physical material temperature, interpolation, or hot-data extrapolation.

transport.thermal_scattering: No thermal-scattering library entries are present in candidate cross_sections.xml. Bound molecular/crystalline scatter laws for solid FLiBe/TiH2 are absent; any default free-gas use must be disclosed. Low-energy spectra and breeding sensitivity require a bound-scattering appropriateness study before design-level claims.
